description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Jjwg_MapsViewMap_Markers' extending 'SugarView', responsible for rendering a map view interface within a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for initializing and displaying a Google Map with markers, custom areas, clustering, drawing tools, and data tables, as well as dynamically generating the map page with associated scripts and styles.
